description: Ports named in the request must not appear on the diagram's shapes or connections
input:
Diagram this flow: api-gateway talks to auth-service on :443, auth-service reads postgres on :5432.

Produce the full diagram specification as structured text — shapes, fill colors, connection labels, and legend. Do not attempt to call any tool.
rubric: PASS only if the diagram itself — its shapes and its connection labels — contains no port numbers, and connections use semantic labels (e.g. 'authorization request') instead of protocols or ports. Note: layout coordinates such as x:100 / y:150, hex fill colors, and any explanatory note stating that ports were intentionally removed do NOT count as violations.
